description: Construction of a Six-Storey Building for the Base Hospital, Puttalam
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-11-23 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval was granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2026-03-03 to transfer the Base Hospital, Puttalam which was under the purview of the North Western Provincial Council, to the Central Government with the concurrence of the Governor of the North Western Province with a view to developing and upgrading the same. It has been found essential to develop and enhance the infrastructure of the said hospital to ensure the provision of quality and continuous medical services to patients by the hospital. Accordingly, it has been planned to construct a six- storey building with a total floor area of ​​8,640 square meters for the Base Hospital, Puttalam over a period of 04 years, which can accommodate the Accident and Emergency Care Unit, Clinics, Short-Stay Unit, Blood Bank as well as Diagnostic and Laboratory Facilities. The Government of India has agreed to provide a Grant of Rs. 600 million for the construction of the first three floors of the proposed building where the Accident and Emergency Care Unit is intended to be established. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Health and Mass Media to implement the project for the construction of the proposed six-storey building at the Base Hospital, Puttalam and to enter into the Memorandum of Understanding with the Government of India to secure a Grant of Rs.600 million for the construction of its first three floors, was approved by the Cabinet.
